rics.meaning: Foreign Tourist Arrivals — international visitor arrivals to Indonesia. Bali dominates (40-50% of arrivals); Jakarta and Batam also significant.
rics.how_to_use: Pre-COVID peak ~16M/year (2019); collapsed to ~4M (2020-21); recovered to ~12M (2024). Tourism is ~5% of GDP. Watch for service-deficit narrowing as arrivals normalize.

rics.description: Foreign tourist arrivals through 3 airports & Batam island
rics.meaning: Foreign Tourist Arrivals through 3 Airports & Batam Island — high-frequency tourism gauge from major entry points (Soekarno-Hatta Jakarta, Ngurah Rai Bali, Kualanamu Medan, Batam).
rics.how_to_use: Higher-frequency than total arrivals (aIDFRGART). Monthly. Useful for spotting recovery momentum or shocks (volcano eruptions, terrorism, geopolitics).
